overall: The AG found the joint Select Board and Planning Board properly entered executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss litigation strategy over a threatened zoning appeal, so no violation.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleged the joint Select Board and Planning Board executive session on Feb 24, 2012 had no valid purpose to discuss a zoning appeal.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Boards appropriately entered into executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss their litigation strategy.
